Simple bulletin for regular visitors
It is easier with this note
Travelers should check their pet papers and carrier setup before coming to the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways.

Bring a calm pet, sturdy leash, and any health records you already have. Keep food and water ready for the wait, and use a secure carrier that gives your animal room to stand and turn. If your pet shows stress, speak up early so the team can slow the pace and help keep the visit smooth.

The desk gives short, clear guidance for routine travel steps, with a focus on safety and comfort. Staff will review basic details, explain what is needed for check-in, and point out anything that could delay a trip. If you have a pet that needs extra care, say so right away so the team can note it and guide you in a simple way. Travelers like Maya Schneider and Leila Wong have found that early preparation makes the visit easier for both them and their animals, including pets like Koda.

Please read the signs, follow the staff directions, and keep your pet close while waiting. If anything changes with your travel plans, let the desk know as soon as you can so the record stays in order.

For help with pet travel, please stop at the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
